records.notes: PG confirmed on the current Siemens Energy SGT-500 service page (global; US and BR identical; the product page is 404 - SGT-500 is a legacy model, absent from the 2026 portfolio). Kept: 19.1 MW(e), 10,651 kJ/kWh, 97.9 kg/s, PR 13:1, 18 compressor stages (LP 10 + HP 8), turbines 1 HP + 2 LP + 3 PT, free power turbine 3,600 rpm. Corrected: exhaust 369 -> 376 C (709 F) per current page. eff_pct 33.8 = 3600/heat rate (derived, task rule): the page prints 33.6 % (PG), which contradicts its own heat rate by 0.2 p.p. - see extra.conflicts. Package dimensions set to null: prelim 21.3 x 4.0 x 5.1 m came from a brochure copy on a host outside the allowed network and are not on the Siemens page; package and engine mass not published. Shafts 'three' read from the page structure (two compressor turbines driving LP and HP compressors + free power turbine; starter on the LP rotor), not printed as a word. Rating conditions not printed (ISO assumed). Added for the replacement: fuel gas 18.0 +/- 0.5 bar(a) at supply, starter <160 kW on the LP rotor via ratchet coupling, tilting-pad bearings, parallel-shaft double helical gearbox 3,600 -> 1,500/1,800 rpm with 4 sleeve bearings, gas generator exchange as a module. Only one manufacturer document reachable: no independent second source for any number. Skeptic check 14.11.2026: exhaust 376 C, package dimensions null and the eff_pct provenance re-read on the global and US pages; eff_pct 33.8 (3600/HR) vs printed 33.6 left UNRESOLVED (extra.conflicts[eff_pct].skeptic). Exhaust 376 C: q = 1.039 is inside 0.88-1.06 but above the 1.029 maximum of the prelim records (369 C would give 1.019); 369 C came from a search extract only.
